## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue (if any).

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: A new feature or tool
- [ ] `fix`: A bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without behavior change
- [ ] `test`: Added or updated tests

## Checklist

- [ ] My commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] I have run `bun run lint` and fixed any warnings
- [ ] I have run `bun run check` and there are no type errors
- [ ] I have run `bun test` and all tests pass
